reuse.why: Extends the existing applyWeekendRule/WeekendRule with holidays and adds a shared isHoliday, and the new handler reuses recurConfigToRSchedule/RSchedule/applyWeekendRule, but getDateWithSkippedWeekend is left behind as a now-divergent exported helper and the daily-skip rule gets no shared helper.

duplication.why: The daily-weekend/holiday skip predicate (frequency === 'daily' && skipWeekend && (isWeekend || isHoliday)) is written three times (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange) along with ad hoc over-fetch counts, and getDatesInRange re-creates getUpcomingDates' occurrence->filter->applyWeekendRule->dayFromDate pipeline.

placement.why: Holiday detection and the moving rule correctly live in shared/schedules.ts, but the daily-skip rule is decided in server handlers and in getNextDate separately instead of in the shared schedule layer, and the budget schedule-template path (getNextDate with noSkipWeekend + applyWeekendRuleToDay) never gets it.

scope.why: Changes stay on the schedule date rule, the new handler and the type, apart from a gratuitous import reorder.

maintainability.why: A future change to which days are skipped must be made in three hand-rolled filters with different magic look-ahead sizes (holidays.length + 8, count + holidays + count, holidays + 2), and getDateWithSkippedWeekend no longer matches applyWeekendRule.

bypasses_abstraction.where: app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange filter daily weekend/holiday occurrences themselves instead of going through a shared schedule rule; applyWeekendRule stops delegating to getDateWithSkippedWeekend and re-implements the move loop; schedule-template.ts recomputes dates without the daily skip.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-skip predicate appears as skipDailyWeekend + dates.find in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate, as dailySkip + filter in getUpcomingDates, and as an inline negated filter in getDatesInRange, each with a differently sized look-ahead window.

abstraction_drift.where: WeekendRule/applyWeekendRule gains a holidays parameter; getNextDate gains a daily-only branch for the take size and for picking the occurrence; getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange re-implement the daily skip and schedule-template.ts computes dates without it.
